nodes.title: Chiller Operations
nodes.summary: Overview of chiller startup and shutdown procedures
nodes.text_preview: This section covers Carrier 30XA chiller operations including startup sequence, safety checks, and shutdown procedures.

nodes.title: Startup Procedure
nodes.text_preview: 1. Verify power. 2. Check oil levels. 3. Start chilled water pump. 4. Activate compressor.

nodes.title: Safety Limits
nodes.text_preview: CHW low limit: 4°C. CHW high limit: 15°C. Oil pressure minimum: 25 psi.
